title: HEAD E-COMMERCE
description:
**Role Description** 
 The Head E\-Commerce is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Kottayam, responsible for leading and growing Oxygen’s online retail business. The role involves defining and executing the e\-commerce strategy, managing the online product catalog, pricing, promotions, and customer experience across digital channels. The Head E\-Commerce will collaborate with sales, marketing, and operations teams to integrate online and offline initiatives, drive traffic, optimize conversion rates, and improve overall revenue and profitability. Daily tasks include analyzing performance data, overseeing digital campaigns, coordinating with brand partners, supervising platform enhancements, and ensuring timely execution of online orders and customer service standards. This role also requires mentoring a cross\-functional team, monitoring market trends, and identifying new opportunities for digital growth.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong E\-Commerce and Business Planning skills to design, implement, and scale online retail strategies.
* Proficient Marketing and Sales skills to drive traffic, engagement, and revenue across digital and physical channels.
* Advanced Analytical Skills to interpret data, optimize conversion funnels, manage budgets, and support decision\-making.
* Experience in managing online marketplaces, brand websites, or omnichannel retail environments.
* Proven leadership and team management capabilities, with the ability to coordinate cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, E\-Commerce, or a related field; a master’s degree or relevant certifications are an advantage.
* Prior experience in consumer electronics or digital products retail is highly beneficial.

title: Sales And Marketing Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 Elrics is a technology\-driven custom software development company focused on building innovative, scalable, and user\-friendly digital solutions. The team specializes in custom software, web and mobile applications, ERP and CRM systems, learning management platforms, and business automation tools for organizations of different sizes. Elrics also develops institutional and enterprise portals that help streamline operations and improve digital experiences. By combining technology, strategy, and creativity, the company supports businesses, educational institutions, startups, and enterprises in accelerating growth. Its mission is to transform ideas into secure, future\-ready digital products.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Sales and Marketing Specialist internship at Elrics is an on\-site role based in Kottayam. Interns will support day\-to\-day sales activities such as identifying potential clients, following up on leads, presenting services, and assisting in closing deals under guidance. They will help execute marketing initiatives, including online and offline campaigns, social media outreach, and basic market research to understand client needs and competitive offerings. The role involves interacting with prospective and existing customers, responding to inquiries, and contributing to customer engagement and satisfaction. Interns may also assist in preparing sales materials, presentations, and reports, and take part in training sessions to develop sales and marketing skills.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Communication and Customer Service skills to engage professionally with clients and stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess Sales and Sales Management skills to support lead generation, client outreach, and pipeline tracking.
* Candidates should possess Training\-related skills, including the ability to learn quickly and share product knowledge with customers and team members.
* Basic understanding of marketing principles, digital channels, and branding is beneficial.
* Interest in technology and software solutions, with the ability to understand and explain product features.
* Ability to work collaboratively on\-site in Kottayam, with a proactive and organized approach to tasks.
* Relevant coursework or experience in business, marketing, communications, or related fields is an advantage.

title: Performance Marketing Specialist - D2C
description:
**Role Overview**
 The Performance Marketing Specialist will be responsible for planning, executing, optimizing,
   

  

 and scaling paid digital campaigns across multiple brands and business verticals.
   

  

 The role will have a strong focus on Meta Ads and Google Ads, with responsibility for driving
   

  

 measurable growth across D2C websites, marketplaces, and other digital channels.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be highly analytical, commercially minded, and comfortable working
   

  

 across multiple brands, audiences, products, and campaign objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Campaign Strategy \& Execution
* Plan, launch, manage, and optimize performance marketing campaigns across Meta
* and Google Ads.
* Develop full\-funnel paid media strategies covering awareness, acquisition, conversion,
* and retention.
* Manage prospecting, remarketing, dynamic ads, lookalike audiences, and other relevant
* campaign formats.
* Develop channel strategies based on individual brand objectives, target audiences, and
* business goals.
* Manage campaigns across multiple brands and categories.
* Budget \& Performance Management
* Plan monthly campaign budgets and allocate spends across channels and brands.
* Optimize campaigns against key metrics including CAC, ROAS, CTR, CPC, CPM, CR,
* and revenue.
* Identify opportunities to scale campaigns while maintaining profitability and efficiency.
* Monitor campaign spend and ensure effective utilization of marketing budgets.
* Continuously evaluate channel and campaign\-level performance.
* Creative Testing \& Optimization
* Work closely with Brand, Creative, and Content teams to develop performance\-oriented
* ad creatives.
* Identify creative concepts, formats, messaging, and offers that can improve campaign
* performance.
* Conduct A/B testing across creatives, audiences, messaging, landing pages, and
* campaign structures.
* Use performance data to provide actionable feedback to creative teams.
* Analytics \& Reporting
* Monitor campaign performance on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.
* Analyze performance data and identify trends, opportunities, and issues.
* Prepare regular performance reports and communicate key insights to management.
* Use GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Looker Studio, and other relevant
* analytics tools.
* Track customer acquisition, conversion, revenue, and profitability metrics.
* Make data\-driven recommendations to improve campaign efficiency and business
* outcomes.
* D2C \& Marketplace Growth
* Drive traffic, customer acquisition, and conversions for D2C websites.
* Support marketplace performance initiatives, including platforms such as Amazon and
* other relevant marketplaces.
* Collaborate with e\-commerce teams on promotions, launches, offers, and seasonal
* campaigns.
* Align paid media campaigns with broader brand and commercial objectives.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Work closely with Brand, Creative, Content, E\-commerce, Sales, and Technology
* teams.
* Translate business objectives into measurable digital marketing campaigns.
* Coordinate campaign launches around new products, promotions, seasonal events, and
* brand initiatives.
* Support multiple brands simultaneously while maintaining brand\-specific strategies.


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 3–4 years of hands\-on performance marketing experience.
* Strong experience managing Meta Ads and Google Ads.
* Experience with D2C, FMCG, Healthcare, Consumer, E\-commerce, or multi\-brand
* businesses is preferred.
* Experience managing campaigns with significant monthly advertising budgets is an
* advantage.
* Experience working across multiple brands or product categories is highly preferred.
* Technical Skills
* Meta Ads Manager
* Google Ads
* Google Analytics 4 (GA4\)
* Google Tag Manager
* Looker Studio / Data Studio
* Conversion Tracking
* Audience \& Campaign Segmentation
* Remarketing
* A/B Testing
* Landing Page Optimization
* Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
* Excel / Google Sheets


**Compensation \& Benefits**
* Competitive salary based on experience.
* Performance\-based incentives.
* Provident Fund (PF).
* Comprehensive medical insurance.
* Mobile/telephone reimbursement.
* Learning and professional development opportunities.


**Why Join?**
* Work with a fast\-growing House of Brands rather than a single\-brand business.
* Work across D2C, B2C, B2B, and omnichannel business models.
* Manage performance marketing across multiple categories, audiences, and markets.
* Directly contribute to customer acquisition, revenue, and brand growth.
* Work closely with Brand, Creative, E\-commerce, and Management teams.
* Opportunity to build scalable performance marketing systems across a growing brand
* portfolio.

title: Performance Marketing & Digital Operations Manager
description:
**The Opportunity** 





 Meta Ads \| Lead Generation \| Team Leadership \| Multi\-Brand Marketing
 




  





 Toptier Solutions Limited is looking for an experienced, highly capable and results\-driven Performance
 



 Marketing \& Digital Operations Manager to lead the digital marketing activities of our growing portfolio
 



 of New Zealand businesses.
 



  





 This is not a routine social\-media posting role. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of
 



 digital growth, generate quality leads, make commercially sound decisions, manage multiple brands,
 



 coordinate staff and freelancers, and report directly to management in New Zealand.
 



  





**PRIMARY OBJECTIVE: GENERATE MORE QUALIFIED LEADS AND MEASURABLE** 




**BUSINESS GROWTH.** 




  





**Business Portfolio** 




 You will oversee performance marketing and lead\-generation activities across a diversified portfolio of
 



 established and growing New Zealand businesses. The portfolio spans financial services, property, home improvement, consumer products, technology and other commercial activities. Specific business information will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Develop and execute performance\-marketing strategies across multiple New Zealand businesses.
 



 • Plan, launch, manage and optimise Meta Ads across Facebook and Instagram.
 



 • Manage or coordinate Google Ads, landing pages, remarketing and conversion campaigns.
 



 • Take ownership of advertising budgets and allocate spend based on performance.
 



 • Monitor and improve CPL, CPA, CTR, ROAS, conversion rates and lead quality.
 



 • Build prospecting, retargeting, lookalike and full\-funnel campaigns.
 



 • Test creatives, copy, audiences, offers and landing pages continuously.
 



 • Ensure Meta Pixel, Conversion API, GA4 and conversion tracking are correctly implemented.
 



 • Coordinate designers, video editors, content creators, developers and freelancers.
 



 • Recruit, coordinate and manage additional digital\-marketing resources when required.
 



 • Review campaign performance daily and make decisions without waiting for constant instructions.
 



 • Maintain a clear marketing plan for each business and provide concise daily updates plus detailed
 



 weekly/monthly reports.
 



 • Identify weak campaigns quickly and take corrective action.
 



 • Understand the full journey from advertisement to lead to appointment to sale.
 



  





**Who We Are Looking For** 




 Experienced. Analytical. Commercially minded. Accountable.
 



 • A genuine hands\-on Meta Ads specialist with strong commercial judgement.
 



 • A wise, confident decision\-maker who can work independently and take responsibility for results.
 



 • Comfortable managing several businesses simultaneously.
 



 • Capable of leading staff, freelancers and specialist contractors.
 



 • Highly organised, proactive and strong in problem\-solving.
 



 • Confident communicating directly with management in New Zealand.
 



 • Focused on qualified leads, appointments and revenue \- not vanity metrics such as likes and followers.
 



  





**Essential Experience** 




 • Ideally 5\+ years of hands\-on digital/performance marketing experience.
 



 • Strong proven experience with Meta Ads Manager and lead\-generation campaigns.
 



 • Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets and improving CPL/CPA/ROAS.
 



 • Strong knowledge of Meta Ads, retargeting, remarketing, Pixel, Conversion API, GA4, Google Tag
 



 Manager, conversion tracking, A/B testing, landing\-page optimisation, CRM/lead funnels and reporting.
 



 • Experience managing multiple brands, client accounts or business verticals.
 



 • Previous team\-lead, agency or operational\-management experience is highly preferred.
 



  





**How Success Will Be Measured** 




 Qualified leads generated \- Cost per lead \- Cost per qualified appointment \- Lead quality \- Conversion rate \- Campaign ROI / ROAS \- Appointments generated \- Growth in enquiries \& sales
 



  





**What We Offer** 




 • Significant responsibility and freedom to implement good ideas.
 



 • Opportunity to build and lead the marketing team.
 



 • Long\-term career growth as the India\-based delivery team expands.
 



 • Competitive salary based on experience and demonstrated capability.
 



 • Performance incentives may be considered for measurable results.
 



  





**Employment Details** 




 Role Location: Kerala, India
 



 Employment: Full\-Time
 



 Company: Toptier Solutions Limited \- New Zealand
 



 Ideal Candidate: A serious long\-term team member \- not someone looking for a short\-term role
 



 or freelance side project.
 



  





**HOW TO APPLY** 




 Please send the following with your application:
 



 1\. Updated CV
 



 2\. Years of Meta Ads / performance\-marketing experience
 



 3\. Examples of campaigns you personally managed
 



 4\. Approximate monthly advertising budgets managed
 



 5\. Examples of CPL / CPA / ROAS improvements achieved
 



 6\. Experience managing staff, freelancers or agencies
 



 7\. Current salary and expected salary
 



 8\. Notice period / earliest joining date
 



  





**Please also answer:** 
 If you were given six New Zealand businesses to manage from tomorrow, what
 



 would you do in your first 30 days to increase qualified leads?
 



  





 Applications without relevant hands\-on performance\-marketing experience may not be considered.

title: Social Media & Campaign Manager
description:
**Job Summary**

**The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in social media management, paid campaigns, content planning, audience targeting, campaign optimization, and performance analysis.** 




**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and coordinate posts, reels, stories, videos, carousels, and other content formats.

* Set up campaign objectives, audiences, targeting, budgets, creatives, and ad placements.
* Manage Meta Ads and other relevant social media advertising platforms.
* Monitor campaign performance and optimize campaigns to improve results.
* Conduct A/B testing of creatives, audiences, ad copy, and campaigns.

* Excellent knowledge of Meta Ads Manager.
* Strong understanding of social media platforms and their respective content formats.
* Experience managing multiple social media channels.
* Good knowledge of campaign targeting, budgeting, optimization, and performance analysis.
* Experience in lead generation and conversion\-focused campaigns.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and content planning skills.

**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience with Google Ads is an advantage.
* Knowledge of Google Analytics .
* Familiarity with Canva or other creative tools.

* Knowledge of SEO and content marketing is an advantage.
* Experience in the Forex/Finance industry is not mandatory. Candidates with strong digital marketing, social media, and campaign management skills from any industry are welcome to apply.

 What you'll do
 



**On the ground** 



* Plan and run door\-to\-door and local flyer campaigns, and identify the neighborhoods, spots, and events worth targeting
* Represent the brand at pop\-ups, local events, and community activations
* Track which locations and tactics actually drive traffic, and adjust based on what's working



**Social \& influencer** 



* Find, reach out to, and manage relationships with local micro\-influencers and content creators
* Coordinate posts, collaborations, and content, including negotiating small paid or barter deals
* Help create and schedule content across our social channels
* Monitor reach, engagement, and results, and report back on what's landing



 What we're looking for
 


* Comfortable being out in the field and starting conversations with strangers
* Organized enough to juggle multiple campaigns, creators, and deadlines at once
* Social\-media savvy, with a feel for what makes local content perform
* Numbers\-aware, you can tell us what's working and what isn't
